results.title: Skeleton Girls. A Kidnapped Society
results.overview: A young woman on the run must survive a news cycle frenzy in order to escape a dangerous plot involving a notorious girl gang.

results.title: We Are Metal Dragon
results.overview: A rock band in the 80s made a promise to never give up on their dream of becoming the next Iron Maiden. Forty years later, they're still rehearsing in the same garage - and realize that dream will never come true. They decide to go out on one final tour... where everything goes hilariously wrong.

results.title: Potwash
results.overview: Isaac, a quiet kitchen porter in a countryside pub, endures the torment of a cruel head chef while falling for a kind waitress named Charlotte.

results.title: Moth
results.overview: Eight burning suns rise and fall over a fractured America where digital ghosts, abandoned landscapes, and unstable symbols drift through an endless cycle of decay and renewal. Shut-ins linger at the edges of contemporary life while a solitary avatar embarks on a journey across deserts, suburbs, cornfields, casinos, and simulated worlds, searching for meaning amid the ruins of an image-saturated culture.

results.title: Concerto per la Festa della Repubblica 2026
results.original_title: Concerto per la Festa della Repubblica 2026
results.overview: From the Salone dei Corazzieri in the Quirinale Palace, the traditional concert to mark the 80th anniversary of Italian Republic Day. The Rome Opera House Orchestra, conducted by Michele Mariotti.

results.title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
results.original_title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Reza Oktovian
results.overview: YouTube star and musician Reza Arap takes the hot seat as top Indonesian comics roast his career, controversies and persona in this comedy special.

results.title: Sitter Wanted
results.overview: Jodie responds to a flyer for a sitting job, only to discover the listing was not for a babysitter and there are no children in the home.

results.title: GW:s mord – Styckmordet i Karlskrona
results.overview: A man is reported missing in Karlskrona. Suspicion falls on his son and the son’s boyfriend. Leif GW Persson examines the case.

results.title: Prithibi Bodle Geche
results.overview: An emotional story centered on a group of friends who embark on a trip to Cox's Bazar, where their shared experiences and deep conversations highlight the complexities of their interpersonal relationships. At the heart of the narrative is Ayan, whose struggle with past losses, feelings of loneliness, and deep connection to his grandmother create an poignant atmosphere throughout the journey. The story explores themes of personal growth, the pain of letting go, and the evolving nature of human bonds, capturing both the joy of friendship and the bittersweet reality of how lives and relationships can transform over time.

results.title: Himalaya: Black Ice Edition
results.overview: FOUND Exclusive B&W Edition: Cryptozoologist Yuma Sato enters a newly discovered Himalayan ice cave to search for the mythical "Snow Ghost." Broadcasting live, his camera reveals shocking finds. Is it an internet hoax or a major scientific breakthrough?

results.title: Tavvai
results.overview: In 1880, A Maharaj through his atrocities invited Tavvai. The village is terrified for generations until a chosen one sets things right.

results.title: Deadbeat
results.overview: Journey into the lives of Father's fighting to be with their children. As they face an uphill battle against a biased system pushing a Fatherless agenda. Wrongfully Accused, False Accusations, Child Support and Meritless Restraining Orders

results.title: Ghosthing
results.overview: A stoic mortician endowed with the ability to perceive the deceased finds his quiet existence upended when the dramatic spirit of a high-profile influencer refuses to depart, forcing him into an unauthorized investigation to prove her sudden demise was the result of homicide.

results.title: Tide-Stone
results.overview: Every being has dreams in their own way.

results.title: We, the Inheritors
results.overview: My parents want us to inherit their life's work. We must talk. About expectations and ideals. About privileges and burdens. But also, about money.

results.title: Alpha Alice
results.overview: Alice cannot find an apartment in Munich for her psychology studies. Out of desperation, she accepts the offer of a man who wants to be treated as a slave by his roommate. In her private life, Alice is rather shy, but in her new role she learns to take control, not only over her roommate Olaf, but also over her own life. An unusual friendship develops between Alice and Olaf, giving them both the sense of security they have been looking for.

results.title: Little Creatures
results.overview: Brasília, 1986. Helena has barely settled in with her family in Brazil's futuristic capital when her husband leaves on a business trip. Stranded in an unfamiliar city, she questions her choices, feeling frustrated and lost. Her teenage son rebels and discovers his first love; her seven-year-old finds magic in unlikely friendships and unseen possibilities. In a democracy less than a year old, everyone lives in limbo—trapped between what was and what could be.

results.title: Erratics
results.overview: Freeing himself after spending a hundred years trapped in a glacier, the ghost of the filmmaker Lucien Castelnau wanders through a futuristic Patagonia, where technological progress clashes with forgotten stories. Unable to rest while his cinematic legacy remains unseen, he crosses a world that has deleted him from its memory, in search of a place in history and of spectators, who can finally bring his lost work back to life.

results.title: Dracula in Space
results.overview: When the deep‑space vessel Orpheus discovers a centuries‑old derelict drifting at the edge of a black hole, the crew retrieves a sealed sarcophagus from its ruins. Soon after, crew members begin to disappear. Something ancient has awakened in the void - Dracula himself, exiled to the stars and hungry after centuries of confinement.
